claim.statement: Current OpenCode Zen documentation describes Zen as an optional US-hosted model gateway and states model-dependent retention boundaries, including exceptions for named free endpoints and thirty-day retention for OpenAI and Anthropic requests.

source.title: OpenCode Zen

limitations: This claim applies only when Zen is selected and remains conditional on the chosen model/provider route; it does not describe external-provider privacy terms.
unknowns: Whether Zen was selected, the selected model route, request region, retention exception, account policy and effective downstream-provider terms are unknown.
